message: Build a polished single-file index.html landing page for Ember, a fictional neighborhood pottery studio. Include hero, three class cards with schedules and fictional prices, instructor intro, FAQ and a CTA scrolling to class details. No booking backend, data collection, external assets or build tools. Use original CSS artwork, responsive layouts, keyboard access and reduced motion.

profile.audience: Adults seeking a calm creative hobby
profile.care: Warmth, legible schedules and honest CTAs
profile.sections: use the sections in the brief
profile.platform: local Windows and Python 3 stdlib for CLI; modern desktop/mobile browser for web
profile.defaults: Smallest solution described; no accounts, network, deployment or paid assets. Ask before scope or budget changes.
